simple.meaning: רַע (raʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 666 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 2:9. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רַע (H7451).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רַע (raʻ) / H7451 is traced through Genesis 2:9, Genesis 2:17, Genesis 3:5, Genesis 3:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.
